title: Slide 3: FUNCTIONAL VISITS SUPPORT EVERYDAY RELEVANCE

items.text: The official store list includes MAKO, J.CO, fashion brands, optical retailers and electronics. Immigration Batam also confirms passport and stay-permit services at the Pollux Immigration Lounge.
Services create a specific reason to visit.
Everyday F&B and retail can capture spending around that visit.
The mixed-use setting offers a potential local customer base.
Useful services should contribute to the district’s weekday relevance.
Service-user conversion into tenant spending, weekday footfall and current vacancy.
Visual: Diagram sederhana hubungan service visit dengan café/retail. Jangan mengasumsikan captive residents otomatis menjadi pelanggan aktif.
SOURCE: SUPPLIED BRIEF · RESEARCH DATE NOT SPECIFIED / 03

Retail and dining provide useful activities around travel.
Programming gives visitors additional reasons to spend time.
Regional demand requires a practical route to the destination: transport, booking and partner distribution.
Ferry-passenger conversion, visitor origin, transfer friction and package demand.

title: Slide 7: PROGRAMMING ADDS REASONS TO VISIT

items.text: Disbudpar Batam documents the Wonderfood event at K Square on 9–17 April 2026, involving 40 businesses with culinary and entertainment activities. It also records a February 2026 film premiere at Cinépolis K Square.
Culinary and entertainment can attract different audiences.
Successful activation needs conversion into surrounding tenant activity.
The Veranda needs a funded programme and operating team from the outset.
Event-day uplift, ordinary-day traffic, net event contribution and current permanent tenant mix.
Visual: Permanent tenant activity dibandingkan dengan event-day activation.
Catatan: Kehadiran event membuktikan kegiatan berlangsung; belum membuktikan uplift atau profitabilitas.
SOURCE: SUPPLIED BRIEF · RESEARCH DATE NOT SPECIFIED / 07
